scope: scripts/probe_protocol91.py's four connectionless checks against an fnTech3 Quake Live dedicated server on loopback: protocol 91 in getinfo, the FnQL nonce echo, the retail binary SteamID/ticket challenge and silence for a malformed ticket.

runsUtc.basis: modification times of the probe's output files

harness: .tmp/probe-records/protocol91_run.py (local, not committed): starts the server on a private desktop, waits for getstatus, runs the probe, then stops the server.

server.platform: Windows 11 x64 host, Windows x86 build: meson/build/win32-dev, MSVC 19.44, debugoptimized, strict warnings, renderers glx/vk/rtx as modules; RTCW, WolfET and Elite Force development gates on
server.command: +set com_gameProfile quakelive +set fs_basepath E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Quake Live +set fs_homepath .tmp\probe-records\protocol91\server-home +set dedicated 1 +set net_ip 127.0.0.1 +set net_port 54826 +set sv_pure 0 +set bot_enable 0 +set logfile 2 +set sv_master1  +set sv_master2  +set sv_master3  +set sv_master4  +set sv_master5  +map campgrounds ffa

environment: Dedicated server on an unswitched private desktop with an isolated fs_homepath, bound to 127.0.0.1 on a free port, pure and bots off; the probe sends from an ephemeral loopback port.
